# 🍎🍊 Apple vs Orange Classifier

## About

This is a simple Machine Learning practice exercise I created while learning the basics of classification and Decision Trees.

The goal was to train a model to distinguish between an **Apple** and an **Orange** based on simple input features.

## 🤖 Model Used

* Decision Tree Classifier
* Python
* Scikit-learn

## 🔄 What I Practiced

* Creating a small dataset
* Separating features and labels
* Training a Decision Tree model
* Making predictions using new input data
* Visualizing the Decision Tree

## 🎯 Purpose

This was a beginner-level practice exercise to understand how a Machine Learning model learns from labeled data and uses the learned patterns to make predictions.

This exercise helped me build a basic understanding before working on more structured Machine Learning projects.
